_meta.description: Asset inventory with criticality and normal role - grounding input for AI-augmented alert triage (MSAI515 project). Source of truth: this file. Deployed copy: soc-asset-inventory index on brisket OpenSearch.
_meta.review: Roles for dojo/regscale and the opnsense IP operator-confirmed 2026-09-01; criticality tiers stand as drafted
_meta.criticality_scale: critical > high > medium > low; multiplier used by the turnover priority scorer

assets.role: SOC automation core: Shuffle SOAR, Ollama LLM, Grafana, Wazuh manager + indexer (OpenSearch). Ubuntu server. Normal: heavy localhost service traffic, OpenSearch queries, Discord webhook egress.
assets.notes: If compromised, the whole response pipeline is compromised.

assets.role: Telemetry store: ELK/OpenSearch (Zeek logs), Kibana, Arkime full-packet capture, Elastic detection engine. Normal: high-volume ingest from sensors, dashboard traffic from PITBOSS.
assets.notes: Network-plane detection alerts fire with this host.name (sensor view).

assets.role: Proxmox hypervisor hosting lab VMs (DC01, WS01, thehive, and others). Normal: cluster/storage chatter, backup traffic to pbs.
assets.notes: Same-hypervisor VM-to-VM traffic is invisible to the SPAN sensor.

assets.role: Active Directory domain controller (lab domain). Windows Server, Elastic Defend endpoint. Normal: logon success/logoff, Kerberos, group policy - routine AD operation.
assets.notes: Identity tier; scheduled background alert noise at :03 and :26 past the hour is a known noise job.

assets.role: Primary admin workstation (Windows 11 laptop, RTX 3060). Admin access to every SOC service. Normal: Kibana/Grafana/Shuffle UI sessions, RDP/SSH to lab hosts, WiFi Direct/Miracast discovery noise (T1092 false positives).
Internet-facing web server (Caddy; public websites + analytics). Normal: constant external SSH brute force and web scanning - expected internet noise. Runs soc-sentinel.sh watchdog.
assets.notes: Only internet-exposed host; alerts here weight higher for exploit-class rules, lower for brute-force noise.

assets.role: SPAN-port network sensor running Suricata. Normal: high-volume protocol anomaly alerts (Ethertype unknown, STUN, unrecognized HTTP auth) that are capture noise, not attacks.
assets.notes: Loss of this host = loss of network visibility.

assets.role: Case management: TheHive + Cortex analyzers. Normal: API traffic from Shuffle workflows on brisket, analyzer egress (AbuseIPDB, Shodan, VirusTotal).
Proxmox Backup Server. Normal: nightly backup traffic from pitcrew.
assets.notes: Backup integrity target - ransomware would come here.

assets.role: Windows 10/11 workstation in the AD lab, Elastic Defend endpoint. Normal: AD logons, Windows update, endpoint telemetry.
assets.notes: Same hypervisor as DC01 - their mutual traffic is SPAN-dark.

assets.role: Linux laptop (GTX 1650 Ti): dev box and purple-team attacker platform. Normal: SSH to lab hosts, git sync; during exercises, attack traffic toward VLAN 30/40.
assets.notes: Alerts with sear as source during an exercise window are expected red activity.

assets.role: Caldera adversary-emulation server (port 8888). Normal: quiet outside exercises; sandcat agent beaconing during campaigns.
assets.notes: Traffic involving VLAN 40 targets or sandcat = campaign, not intrusion.

assets.role: DefectDojo vulnerability management platform. Normal: scan-result imports, web UI sessions from PITBOSS, quiet otherwise.
RegScale GRC/compliance platform. Normal: compliance web UI and API traffic, quiet otherwise.
Wazuh manager pseudo-agent (runs on brisket): processes OPNsense firewall syslog. Normal: 'Brute Force' alerts from this agent are firewall WAN-block events, not attacks on Wazuh.
Perimeter firewall/router (OPNsense), no Wazuh agent; visibility via syslog to wazuh.manager. Normal: WAN-side drop events from internet scanning.
assets.notes: Unmanaged asset included for alert-context grounding. IP operator-confirmed 2026-09-01.
